bukti: The dataset consists of approximately 10.000 images of oil palm fruit.
The suggested technique achieves a mean test accuracy of 96.12% ± 0.39% (max 96.86%) across 10 independent runs
To enhance the diversity and practicality of the dataset, we selected a range of indoor and outdoor scenes.
catatan: Klasifikasi kematangan empat kelas dari citra RGB tunggal 224x224; hasil utama di Tabel 11, h. 15. Lokasi tandan tidak dinyatakan tegas (adegan dalam dan luar ruang, sebagian dari Roboflow). Tidak ada penggabungan beberapa pandangan atas tandan yang sama.

bukti: This study presents a comprehensive analysis of four YOLOv8 variations to identify and locate raspberries by their ripeness levels.
The YOLOv8l model emerged as the accurate among them achieving the mAP50 and mAP50 95 scores at 78.6% and 47.5%, respectively.
catatan: Deteksi dengan atribut kelas kematangan pada citra tunggal (RaspberrySet); abstrak tidak menyebut pencacahan, sehingga C4 dipilih sebagai kelompok terdekat untuk deteksi beratribut kelas. Bila C4 mensyaratkan cacah eksplisit, alternatifnya X/E5.

bukti: This paper focuses on the detection of citrus fruits in the tree canopy under variable illumination and different degree occlusion.
The 3-D surface topography of the visible parts of fruits were recovered by the classical algorithm of shade from shading
catatan: Deteksi jeruk di tajuk dari citra RGB tunggal tanpa pencacahan dan tanpa evaluasi di luar deteksi. Permukaan 3D diperoleh dari shape from shading pada citra RGB, bukan dari sensor kedalaman, sehingga C5 tidak dipilih; abstrak tidak melaporkan evaluasi kuantitatif lokalisasi.

bukti: the photos of pineapple with different maturity were marked, and the labels were divided into yellow ripeness and green ripeness
The results showed that MobileNet V3-YOLOv4 achieved an mAP of 90.92%, which was 5.28% higher than YOLOv4 and 3.67% higher than YOLOv3.

experimental studies on a newly developed visual and tactile dataset were conducted

catatan: Artikel Nongye Jixie Xuebao berbahasa Mandarin dengan abstrak Inggris. Dari sisi isi pun kajian ini adalah klasifikasi kematangan per buah dengan fusi citra dan sensor taktil untuk pemetikan, tanpa pencacahan (mendekati E5/E4). Bahasa teks lengkap didasarkan pada halaman penerbit, bukan pada PDF.

bukti: Este trabajo presenta un sistema de reconocimiento capaz de identificar una fruta tropical latinoamericana de entre un conjunto, establecido en una base de datos

la construccion de una bascula electronica capaz de clasificar frutas, dispositivo que pretende contribuir a la solucion del problema de identificacion y clasificacion de productos agricolas en los supermercados

bukti: a robust computer vision pipeline for accurately detecting, tracking, and counting melons using the You Only Look Once version 11 nano object detection model
front row strict annotation and line counting tracking combination which yielded a counting error rate of just 2.74%
The system was tested on footage captured by an automated guide vehicle in a greenhouse

bukti: tackling the problem from two different approaches: applying forced air flow by means of an air-assisted sprayer, and using multi-view sensing
The system was able to detect and localize more than 80% of the visible fruits, predict the yield with a root mean square error lower than 6%
combining trials with and without forced air flow and multi-view sensing presented significant advantages for fruit detection
catatan: Pindaian LiDAR dari beberapa pandangan dan beberapa percobaan digabung, sehingga buah yang sama teramati lebih dari sekali; M4 (awan titik teregistrasi) disimpulkan dari sifat data, abstrak tidak merinci cara registrasi maupun penghapusan duplikat.
